_comment: Definitions, not dashboards: versioned with the app and never edited in place.
Each names the registers and schemas it reads; one the instance lacks is listed as unavailable with those names.
aggregation.kind is one of ReportDefinitions::KINDS: count-by (rows per value of a property) or area (AreaAggregation).

reports.title: Open cases by handler
reports.description: How many cases that have not reached a final status each handler holds.

reports.title: Cases per area
reports.description: Cases started in a period per area, with the share of each and the cases without a location counted apart.

reports.title: Dashboards by type
reports.description: How many dashboards of each type this instance holds.
